[SWS_PER_00477]
d
When
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::ResetKey
is called
for a
key-value pair
that is present in the
manifest
,
Persistency
shall reset
the given
key
to the state it would have after installation of the
application
using the
current
manifest
information.
c
(RS_PER_00009, RS_PER_00010, RS_PER_00012)
